brief.zh: 已知「下雨 → 地湿」和「地湿 → 路滑」，证出「下雨 → 路滑」。
brief.en: Given “it rains → the ground is wet” and “the ground is wet → the road is slippery”, prove “it rains → the road is slippery”.

hint.zh: 目标是一句「如果下雨，那么…」：假设「下雨」，看能套用出什么。
hint.en: The goal is “if it rains, then …”: assume “it rains” and see what Apply gets you.

t.zh: 两段「如果…那么…」首尾相接。要证一句「如果…那么…」，先假设它的前一半。
t.en: Two “if … then …”s meet end to end. To prove an “if … then …”, assume its first half.

after.zh: 要证「如果…那么…」，就假设它的前一半。下一个专题会拿掉框，看同一件事要费多少力气。
after.en: To prove an “if … then …”, assume its first half. The topic that follows takes the box away to see what the same thing costs.
